customer: Honestly this is the last thing I need with a newborn at home. I just got a recall notice on my hatchback and I'm trying to sell it to you, so does this mean my offer is toast or I have to drag it to a dealer first?
agent: I'm sorry for the stress, especially with a new baby at home. The good news is that we do buy cars with open safety recalls, and an open recall doesn't change your offer. Recall repairs are free at a dealer for your car's brand, so you can get it fixed before selling if you'd like, but you don't have to.
